description: Fetch a single email by id. Use after list_recent_emails/check_new_emails to read or summarize a specific message. IMPORTANT: `body` is always null for RECEIVED mail. Bottled never stores inbound bodies, and no setting changes that, so the message text is not retrievable here and only the subject, sender and AI summary describe it. Never draft a reply as though you had read a received message; say the text is unavailable and point the user at their forwarding inbox. Bodies are present for SENT mail (always for app and auto-reply sends, and for API sends from an address with 'save email body' on).
name: get_email
